review.tagline: Self-hosted web UI for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible models with users and RAG
review.summary: Open WebUI is a self-hosted chat front-end for Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API, such as vLLM, LMStudio, OpenRouter or Groq. It adds role-based access control, chat history, document RAG with 9 vector database options, web search, voice calls, image generation and a plugin system (Filters, Pipes, Tools, MCP). It installs via pip, Docker or Kubernetes and serves on port 8080 by default.
review.audience: Self-hosters and teams running a shared chat UI over local or API models
strengths: Works with Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so local and cloud models mix in one UI
RBAC, user groups, LDAP, OAuth/SSO and SCIM 2.0 provisioning for multi-user deployments
RAG with hybrid BM25 plus vector search and 9 vector databases, including ChromaDB, PGVector and Qdrant
SQLite or PostgreSQL, S3/GCS/Azure storage, Redis and OpenTelemetry for scaled deployments
weaknesses: Custom license requires preserving Open WebUI branding; not a standard OSS license
Per-user isolated terminals are in the Enterprise edition only
Very broad feature set, so the many settings take time to configure
Does not run models itself; needs Ollama or an API unless using the :ollama image
needs: Needs Ollama or OpenAI-compatible API, Docker (optional), PostgreSQL (optional), Redis (optional)
Models: Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, vLLM, LMStudio, GroqCloud
